This position manages the academic, developmental, and day-to-day operations of the Yardi Scholars Program, including student support, program development and delivery, cohort programming, assessment, and coordination with faculty and campus partners.

Develops, coordinates, implements, and assesses Yardi Scholars academic and co-curricular programming, including cohort learning experiences, retreats, speaker salons, workshops, community-building activities, mentorship opportunities, and other programming aligned with program goals.

Provides direct academic, developmental, and programmatic support to Yardi Scholars through individual meetings, coaching, advising, mentoring, referrals, and other student-support formats. Supports scholars in navigating academic challenges, educational transitions, Discovery experiences, and connections among their academic, experiential, and longer-term goals.

Supports and collaborates with the Yardi Scholars Faculty Director, SLC Leadership, faculty, academic departments, advising units, and campus partners to coordinate curricular requirements, experiential learning opportunities, scholar support, and overall program delivery.

Applies and implements academic support, student development, experiential learning, and cohort-based educational models to enhance scholar learning, intellectual development, belonging, reflection, and engagement. Designs and pilots new programming as scholar and program needs evolve.

Develops and implements approaches for assessing scholar experiences, engagement, learning, and program effectiveness. Collects and analyzes qualitative and quantitative information and recommends improvements to program content, services, policies, and practices.

Supports the Yardi Scholars application review and selection process in collaboration with the Office of Financial Aid and Scholarships and other relevant campus partners, including reviewing application materials, participating in selection activities, and helping ensure alignment with established program criteria and cohort goals.

Coordinates program communications, records, reports, briefings, program documentation, and administrative processes. Works with appropriate campus partners on program expenditures, scholarship-related processes, Discovery support, and other operational needs.

Keeps abreast of research, emerging practices, curricular developments, and campus policies relevant to undergraduate learning, student development, academic support, experiential education, and the Yardi Scholars Program.
Serves on Student Learning Center and campus-wide committees and contributes to Center-wide initiatives, planning, professional learning, and evolving operational needs.

Knowledge of or demonstrated interest in democracy, technology, social change, civic engagement, or related areas relevant to the Yardi Scholars curriculum.
